'''Garrison Avery''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1998 Bespin Regional (Minneapolis)]] on 22 August 1998 with LS Alien, Drain, Tessek deck, according to Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1275">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-27-old-bespin-regional-98d1275/ old-bespin-regional-98], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 27 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-27-old-bespin-regional-98d1275/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
